mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES fell 19.1 points in the final week to -50.1, the steepest weekly decline in the window, and workplace trips are the lead input to weekday retail footfall; the collapse therefore propagates into a lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped from -31.0 at t-1w to -50.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to the last-28-day mean of -24.0 while WORKPLACES remains below -40.0.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has fallen in every week of the window and crossed below -45.0 at t-0w (-47.1), the level at which containment stringency binds discretionary trips; retail-and-recreation footfall follows transit down within two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT declined from -37.0 at t-3w to -47.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean exceeds the last-28-day mean of -24.0 within two weeks of TRANSIT sitting below -45.0.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL rising to +5.0 while WORKPLACES falls to -50.1 marks a stay-at-home substitution regime; hours reallocated to the home cut discretionary out-of-home retail trips, so the joint movement pushes RETAIL_REC lower over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose to +5.0 while WORKPLACES fell to -50.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL stays above +4.0 and WORKPLACES stays below -40.0.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS at +58.0 is the highest reading in the window while RETAIL_REC fell to -33.1; outdoor leisure is absorbing discretionary time and spend that would otherwise land in indoor retail venues, so RETAIL_REC keeps falling over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped from 37.1 at t-1w to 58.0 at t-0w while RETAIL_REC fell from -22.3 to -33.1
failure_condition: In weeks where PARKS exceeds +50.0, RETAIL_REC does not fall below its value in the preceding week.

mechanism_narrative: The -10.8 point week-on-week fall in RETAIL_REC at t-0w is more than four times any prior weekly move in the window, identifying a transient shock rather than a new level; retail reverts toward the -21.0 three-week pre-shock mean, lifting the next 28-day mean above -24.0.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC weekly mean falls more than 8.0 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell 10.8 points from -22.3 at t-1w to -33.1 at t-0w while prior weekly moves were at most 2.2 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to recover above -25.0 within one week of a drop larger than 8.0 points.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC moved down together in all four weeks, from -17.4 to -27.1 and from -20.6 to -33.1, showing a common trip-suppression factor; with grocery trips still contracting, that shared factor keeps dragging RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:both GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC declined in every week of the four-week window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean is at or above the last-28-day mean of -24.0 while GROCERY_PHARM continues to decline week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES below -40.0 for two consecutive weeks is the marker of enforced workplace closure policy; retail-and-recreation restrictions follow workplace closures with a two-to-four week lag, pushing RETAIL_REC lower across the next month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES weekly mean below -40.0 in two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES was -31.0 at t-1w and -50.1 at t-0w, its first two readings below -40.0
failure_condition: After two consecutive weeks of WORKPLACES below -40.0, the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT collapsing to -47.1 while RESIDENTIAL rises to +5.0 shifts errands from transit-served districts to car-based local corridors; suburban strip retail captures the redirected demand, lifting measured RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT hit -47.1 and RESIDENTIAL hit +5.0 in the same week t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next-28-day mean stays at or below -24.0 while TRANSIT remains under -45.0 and RESIDENTIAL above +4.0.
